description: Developed HORUS, an end-to-end OSINT cyber-news ingestion and processing pipeline for Skill & Reach. Built ingestion (RSS + headless scraping), LLM-based enrichment (classification, tagging, automatic summaries), vector embedding-based deduplication and related-article detection, and an Elasticsearch-backed API with a React control center for exploration and scheduled reports. Delivered containerized tooling with per-source configuration, logging and authentication.
